messages:
cleo: Heads up - we need a 2h ephemeral export of auth logs for the incident reproduce window 2026-06-11T09:00:00Z-2026-06-11T11:00:00Z. Must be HSM-backed, masked, and delivered via signed URL. Who can approve?
ram: i can approve if we use per-export SALT in vault and restrict unwrap to oncall+role, with MFA. No S3 persistent writes.
cleo: plan: user_id -> sha256+SALT, email -> redact, ip -> /24 mask, strip tokens. Generate ephemeral KMS key (key_origin=HSM) with 6h lifetime, pre-signed download URL valid 4h. Store SALT at vault://sec/INC-4022/salt.
kms-ops-bot: policy check: ephemeral HSM keys require ticket and auditor signoff; auto-delete flag must be set.
oncall-zoe: i'm oncall during window; i'll do MFA unwrap and download. Put explicit curl steps in the ticket.
ram: approve conditional on infra PR adding role "incident-ephemeral" scoped to export resource and audithook present.
cleo: created ticket INC-4022. infra PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3010 - adds role and pre-signed flow.
kms-ops-bot: infra PR merged. KMS request KMS-1402 filed for HSM ephemeral key. awaiting ops.
ram: KMS approved, SALT present. approving final export. keep audit events visible: grant, decrypt, download, delete.
cleo: kicking export job now. job id=I-8821. URL expires 4h from 2026-06-11T09:05:00Z.
oncall-zoe: performed MFA, downloaded, verified scrubs applied. saw audit events: authz#I-8821, crypto#I-8821, net#I-8821. scheduling delete in 24h.
cleo: thanks team. follow-ups: add incident ephemeral template to docs and add automated test to ensure no S3 persistence for these exports.
